tasks.title: Mission select thumbnail always renders the shelled wood, not the card's ground
tasks.why: MissionSelectScreen.RefreshThumb (MissionSelectScreen.cs:95) calls MapThumbnail.Render(seed), the one-arg overload that hardcodes Ground.ShelledForest (MapThumbnail.cs:13). WinterLine.asset sets Ground: 1 (WinterLine), and Deploy (MissionSelectScreen.cs:102) does send card.Ground into the match, so picking the Winter Line card shows a shelled-wood preview while the real match loads winter ground. This breaks the promise at MapThumbnail.cs:3 that the picture and the minimap 'agree by construction', and no test in ShellUxmlTests.cs or WinterLevelTests.cs exercises the select screen's thumbnail path (WinterLevelTests only checks MissionCard.ToRequest, never MapThumbnail).
tasks.done_when: RefreshThumb calls MapThumbnail.Render(seed, card.Ground); a new EditMode test selects the WinterLine card and asserts the rendered thumbnail's pixels match MapThumbnail.Render(seed, Ground.WinterLine) rather than the ShelledForest render.

tasks.title: Fix MissionCard.cs comment citing a test class that does not exist
tasks.why: MissionCard.cs:4 says 'MissionCatalogTests holds ShelledWood1917 to seed 1917 and today's knobs', but grep finds that string only in this comment; no MissionCatalogTests class exists anywhere in the repo. The real guard for the default card is in ShellUxmlTests.cs (NoMissionShellsTheFieldAllMatchLong and friends). Anyone following the citation to understand the guarantee finds nothing.
tasks.done_when: the comment names ShellUxmlTests.cs (or the specific test method) instead of MissionCatalogTests; grep -r MissionCatalogTests trench-warfare-3d returns nothing.

tasks.title: FrontLine stat is hand-typed text, never checked against the real map size
tasks.why: MissionCard.FrontLine (MissionCard.cs:41, e.g. "90 x 240 M") is shown verbatim by RefreshStats (MissionSelectScreen.cs: info-stats text) but is never derived from the battlefield the card actually generates (BattlefieldGenerator/MapData for the card's Ground+BattlefieldSeed). ShelledWood1917 and ShelledWoodInland both state "90 x 240 M" for different seeds, and WinterLine states "110 x 240 M" on a different ground entirely, with no test tying any of these strings to the generated map's real dimensions, so a future map-size tweak can silently make the panel lie to the player.
tasks.done_when: a test builds each shipped card's battlefield (BattlefieldGenerator.Create with the card's Ground/BattlefieldSeed) and asserts the generated NavWidth/NavLength matches the card's FrontLine string, failing today or on future drift.
